claims.statement: Aten is an Egyptian sun god represented as the sun disk.
claims.statement_id: Aten adalah dewa matahari Mesir yang dilambangkan sebagai cakram matahari.
claims.quote: At Amarna the sun-god is depicted in radical new style as sun-disk (in Egyptian itn, generally rendered in English as Aten)

claims.statement: Aten's rays end in hands that offer life to the king and women close to him.
claims.statement_id: Sinar Aten digambarkan berujung tangan yang menawarkan kehidupan kepada raja dan perempuan terdekatnya.
claims.quote: with sun-rays terminating in hands offering life to the king and the women nearest to him.

claims.statement: During Akhenaten's reign, Aten was worshipped as the principal deity.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa Akhenaten, Aten disembah sebagai dewa utama.
claims.quote: The Aten, or sun disc, was worshipped as the main deity.

claims.statement: Akhenaten founded Amarna as a center for his beliefs.
claims.statement_id: Akhenaten mendirikan Amarna sebagai pusat keyakinannya.
claims.quote: He founded the palace-city of Amarna as a centre for his religious beliefs.

claims.statement: Akhenaten's reform excluded the cult of other deities.
claims.statement_id: Reformasi Akhenaten membatasi pemujaan dewa lain.
claims.quote: Akhenaten’s religious reforms were not entirely new, but his exclusion of the cult of other deities marks a break with traditions.

claims.statement: The Great Hymn to Aten is a major source for Akhenaten's religious reform.
claims.statement_id: Himne Agung kepada Aten adalah sumber penting untuk memahami reformasi agama Akhenaten.
claims.quote: The Great Hymn to the Aten is our principal source for the radical reformulation of ancient Egyptian belief in the reign of Akhenaten.

claims.statement: In the Great Hymn, Aten is praised as the nurse in the womb who gives breath to cause all he has made to live.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Himne Agung, Aten dipuji sebagai pengasuh dalam rahim yang memberi napas agar semua ciptaannya hidup.
claims.quote: Nurse in the womb, who gives breath to cause all he has made to live,

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, before Akhenaten's reform Aten was a minor solar deity.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebelum reformasi Akhenaten, Aten merupakan dewa matahari yang lebih kecil.
claims.quote: Aten was a minor solar deity who personified the light of the sun.

claims.statement: After Akhenaten's death Tutankhamun moved the capital away from Akhetaten.
claims.statement_id: Setelah kematian Akhenaten, Tutankhamun memindahkan ibu kota dari Akhetaten.
claims.quote: The city flourished until Akhenaten's death; afterwards, Tutankhamun moved the capital back to Memphis and then to Thebes.

claims.statement: Tutankhamun began restoring Egypt's earlier religious practices.
claims.statement_id: Tutankhamun memulai pemulihan praktik keagamaan Mesir terdahulu.
claims.quote: Tutankhamun initiated the measures to reverse his father's policies and return Egypt to the former beliefs and practices

claims.statement: The Amarna temples had open spaces and offering altars.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Aten di Amarna memiliki ruang terbuka luas dan altar persembahan.
claims.quote: The temples at Amarna present vast open spaces with altars for offerings and raised platforms.

claims.statement: In his fifth year of reign, Amenhotep IV changed his birth name to Akhenaten, 'one who is akh for the Aten'.
claims.statement_id: Pada tahun kelima pemerintahannya, Amenhotep IV mengganti namanya menjadi Akhenaten, "yang akh bagi Aten".
claims.quote: In his fifth year of reign, king Amenhotep IV changed his birth name 'Amun-is-content' to Akhenaten 'one who is akh for the Aten'

claims.statement: The king founded a new city, Akhetaten 'Horizon of the Aten', at a desert bay halfway between Memphis and Thebes.
claims.statement_id: Sang raja mendirikan kota baru Akhetaten, "Cakrawala Aten", di teluk gurun di tengah jalan antara Memphis dan Thebes.
claims.quote: He founded a new city Akhetaten 'Horizon of the Aten' at a desert bay at a point halfway between Memphis and Thebes

claims.statement: The Amarna hymn to the sun god is radically different in systematically excluding any other deities.
claims.statement_id: Himne kepada dewa matahari pada masa Amarna berbeda secara radikal karena menyingkirkan dewa-dewa lain secara sistematis.
claims.quote: However, this hymn is radically different in its systematic exclusion of any other deities.

claims.statement: The Great Hymn addresses Aten as rising beautiful from the horizon on heaven, a living disk and origin of life.
claims.statement_id: Himne Agung menyapa Aten yang terbit indah dari cakrawala di langit sebagai cakram yang hidup dan asal kehidupan.
claims.quote: You rise beautiful from the horizon on heaven, living disk, origin of life.

claims.statement: According to the Great Hymn, Aten's rays bind the lands to the limit of all he has made.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Himne Agung, sinar Aten mengikat negeri-negeri sampai batas semua yang ia ciptakan.
claims.quote: Your rays bind the lands to the limit of all you have made, you are the sun, you have reached their limits.

claims.statement: The Great Hymn says Aten is distant yet his rays are on earth; he is in sight, but his movements are hidden.
claims.statement_id: Himne Agung menyebut Aten jauh namun sinarnya ada di bumi; ia terlihat, tetapi gerak-geriknya tersembunyi.
claims.quote: You are distant, but your rays are on earth, You are in their sight, but your movements are hidden.

claims.statement: In the Great Hymn Aten removes the darkness and grants his rays, and the two lands are in festival.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Himne Agung, Aten menyingkirkan kegelapan dan memberikan sinarnya sehingga kedua negeri bersuka ria.
claims.quote: you remove the darkness, you grant your rays, and the two lands are in festival,

claims.statement: The Great Hymn praises Aten as the one who causes seed to grow in women, turns seed into people, and makes the son live in his mother's womb.
claims.statement_id: Himne Agung memuji Aten sebagai yang menumbuhkan benih dalam perempuan, mengubah benih menjadi manusia, dan menghidupkan anak dalam rahim ibunya.
claims.quote: You who cause the sperm to grow in women, who turns seed into people, who causes the son to live in the womb of his mother,

claims.statement: The Great Hymn calls Aten a unique god with none beside him, who moulds the earth to his wish alone.
claims.statement_id: Himne Agung menyebut Aten sebagai dewa tunggal yang tiada duanya dan yang membentuk bumi sesuai kehendaknya seorang diri.
claims.quote: Unique god, there is none beside him. You mould the earth to your wish, you and you alone.

claims.statement: The Great Hymn names a Flood in the sky for foreigners and a Flood from the underworld for Egypt.
claims.statement_id: Himne Agung menyebut banjir di langit bagi bangsa asing dan banjir dari dunia bawah bagi Mesir.
claims.quote: A Flood in the sky for foreigners, for the flocks of every land that go on foot, and a Flood to come from the underworld for Egypt,

claims.statement: The Great Hymn states that Aten makes the seasons to nurture all he made, with winter to cool them and heat.
claims.statement_id: Himne Agung menyatakan Aten membuat musim untuk memelihara semua ciptaannya, dengan dingin musim dingin dan panas.
claims.quote: You make the seasons to nurture all you mae, winter to cool them, heat so they may taste you.

claims.statement: According to the Great Hymn the land comes into being by Aten's action; beings live when he has shone and die when he rests.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Himne Agung, negeri terwujud oleh tindakan Aten; makhluk hidup ketika ia bersinar dan mati ketika ia beristirahat.
claims.quote: The land comes into being by your action, as you make them, and when you have shone, they live, when you rest, they die.

claims.statement: The Great Hymn is inscribed in thirteen columns of hieroglyphs on the west wall of the courtier Ay at Amarna.
claims.statement_id: Himne Agung tertulis dalam tiga belas kolom hieroglif pada dinding barat makam pejabat istana Ay di Amarna.
claims.quote: It is inscribed in thirteen columns of hieroglyphs on the west wall of the courtier Ay at Amarna.

claims.statement: Aten, also written Aton, Atonu, or Itn, was the focus of Atenism, the religious system formally established in ancient Egypt by the pharaoh Akhenaten.
claims.statement_id: Aten, juga ditulis Aton, Atonu, atau Itn, menjadi pusat Atenisme, sistem keagamaan yang dibentuk secara resmi di Mesir kuno oleh firaun Akhenaten.
claims.quote: Aten, also Aton, Atonu, or Itn ... was the focus of Atenism, the religious system formally established in ancient Egypt by the late Eighteenth Dynasty pharaoh Akhenaten.

claims.statement: The worship of Aten and Akhenaten's rule are major identifying features of the Eighteenth Dynasty period called the Amarna Period (c. 1353-1336 BCE).
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan Aten dan pemerintahan Akhenaten menjadi ciri utama masa dalam Dinasti Kedelapan Belas yang disebut Periode Amarna (sekitar 1353-1336 SM).
claims.quote: The worship of Aten and the coinciding rule of Akhenaten are major identifying characteristics of a period within the Eighteenth Dynasty referred to as the Amarna Period (c. 1353 – 1336 BCE).

claims.statement: The word Aten appears in the Old Kingdom as a noun meaning "disc", anything flat and circular; the sun was called the "disc of the day" where Ra was thought to reside.
claims.statement_id: Kata Aten muncul pada masa Kerajaan Lama sebagai kata benda yang berarti "cakram", yaitu apa saja yang datar dan bundar; matahari disebut "cakram siang" tempat Ra diyakini bersemayam.
claims.quote: The word Aten appears in the Old Kingdom as a noun meaning "disc" which referred to anything flat and circular; the sun was called the "disc of the day" where Ra was thought to reside.

claims.statement: The Aten was the disc of the sun and originally an aspect of Ra, the sun god of traditional ancient Egyptian religion.
claims.statement_id: Aten adalah cakram matahari dan pada mulanya merupakan salah satu aspek Ra, dewa matahari dalam agama Mesir kuno tradisional.
claims.quote: The Aten was the disc of the sun and originally an aspect of Ra, the sun god in traditional ancient Egyptian religion.

claims.statement: Under Amenhotep III Aten was the preeminent creator deity of a pantheon; only under his successor did Aten become the only god acknowledged in state worship.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa Amenhotep III, Aten adalah dewa pencipta terkemuka dalam panteon Mesir; baru pada penerusnya Aten menjadi satu-satunya dewa dalam pemujaan negara.
claims.quote: While Aten was the preeminent creator deity of a pantheon of ancient Egyptian gods under Amenhotep III, it was not until his successor that Aten would be the only god acknowledged via state worship.

claims.statement: During the reign of Amenhotep III, Aten was widely worshipped as a solar deity and depicted as a falcon-headed god like Ra.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa Amenhotep III, Aten dipuja luas sebagai dewa matahari dan digambarkan berkepala elang seperti Ra.
claims.quote: Aten was extensively worshipped as a solar deity during the reign of Amenhotep III where it was depicted as a falcon-headed god like Ra.

claims.statement: In Atenism, the Aten created all countries and people and cares for every creature.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Atenisme, Aten menciptakan semua negeri dan manusia serta memelihara setiap makhluk.
claims.quote: The Aten created all countries and people, and cares for every creature.

claims.statement: In inscriptions such as the Hymn to the Aten and the King, the Aten is shown caring for the people through Akhenaten, making the royal family intermediaries for his worship.
claims.statement_id: Dalam prasasti seperti Himne kepada Aten dan Raja, Aten digambarkan memelihara rakyat melalui Akhenaten, sehingga keluarga kerajaan menjadi perantara pemujaan Aten.
claims.quote: In inscriptions, like the Hymn to the Aten and the King, the Aten is depicted as caring for the people through Akhenaten, placing the royal family as intermediaries for the worship of the Aten.

claims.statement: Unlike the traditional enclosed Egyptian temple, temples of the Aten were open and unroofed so that the sun's rays could enter.
claims.statement_id: Berbeda dari tradisi kuil Mesir yang tertutup, kuil Aten terbuka dan tidak beratap agar sinar matahari dapat masuk.
claims.quote: Straying significantly from the tradition of ancient Egyptian temples being hidden and more enclosed the further one went into the site, temples of Aten were open and did not have roofs in order to allow the rays of the sun inside.

claims.statement: Not long after Akhenaten's death, his successor Tutankhamun reopened the state temples to other gods and re-positioned Amun as the pre-eminent solar deity.
claims.statement_id: Tak lama setelah Akhenaten wafat, penerusnya Tutankhamun membuka kembali kuil-kuil negara bagi dewa-dewa Mesir lain dan menempatkan Amun sebagai dewa matahari utama.
claims.quote: Not long after his death, one of Akhenaten's Eighteenth Dynasty successors, Tutankhamun, reopened the state temples to other Egyptian gods and re-positioned Amun as the pre-eminent solar deity.

claims.statement: Some see Akhenaten as practising an Aten monolatry since he did not deny other gods but simply refrained from worshipping them; other scholars call the religion henotheistic.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian sarjana memandang Akhenaten menjalankan monolatri Aten karena ia tidak menyangkal dewa lain, hanya tidak memujanya; sarjana lain menyebut agama itu henoteistik.
claims.quote: Others see Akhenaten as a practitioner of an Aten monolatry, as he did not actively deny the existence of other gods; he simply refrained from worshipping any but the Aten. Other scholars call the religion henotheistic.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, Akhenaten instituted the first known monotheistic state religion in the world and, according to some, monotheism itself.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Akhenaten mendirikan agama negara monoteistik pertama yang diketahui di dunia dan, menurut sebagian orang, monoteisme itu sendiri.
claims.quote: instituted the first known monotheistic state religion in the world and, according to some, monotheism itself.

claims.statement: Diana was a Roman goddess associated with childbirth, fertility, the moon, and wild animals.
claims.statement_id: Diana adalah dewi Romawi yang berkaitan dengan kelahiran, kesuburan, bulan, dan hewan liar.
claims.quote: Diana was the goddess of childbirth, the fertility goddess, the goddess of the moon as well as the patron goddess of wild beasts in Roman mythology.

claims.statement: Diana is best known as a hunt goddess, with the deer as her sacred animal.
claims.statement_id: Diana paling dikenal sebagai dewi perburuan dengan rusa sebagai hewan sucinya.
claims.quote: However, she is best known as the goddess of the hunt, with her sacred animal being the deer.

claims.statement: Diana was identified with the Greek Artemis.
claims.statement_id: Diana disamakan dengan Artemis dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: Her equivalent in Greek mythology is Artemis.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, in Roman genealogy Diana is the daughter of Jupiter and Latona.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam silsilah Romawi Diana adalah putri Jupiter dan Latona.
claims.quote: Diana was the daughter of Jupiter and Latona (the Roman equivalent of Leto), the goddess of dark nights.

claims.statement: Diana and Apollo were said to be born on Delos.
claims.statement_id: Diana dan Apollo dikisahkan lahir di Pulau Delos.
claims.quote: he sent a dolphin to carry Latona to the island of Delos where she gave birth to Apollo and Diana.

claims.statement: Roman art commonly portrays Diana with a bow and quiver.
claims.statement_id: Seni Romawi sering menggambarkan Diana membawa busur dan tabung panah.
claims.quote: In most works of Roman art, Diana is depicted armed with a bow and quiver of arrows

claims.statement: Actaeon appears in one of Diana's best-known stories.
claims.statement_id: Actaeon adalah tokoh dalam salah satu kisah Diana yang paling dikenal.
claims.quote: One of the best-known myths of Diana is that of Actaeon.

claims.statement: In the Actaeon story he grows the horns of a stag, his hands become feet and his arms are changed into legs.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Actaeon, ia tumbuh tanduk rusa jantan, tangannya menjadi kaki, dan lengannya berubah menjadi tungkai.
claims.quote: he grew the horns of a stag, his hands became feet and his arms were changed into legs.

claims.statement: An important Roman sanctuary of Diana stood at Aricia by Lake Nemi.
claims.statement_id: Tempat suci Diana yang penting bagi orang Romawi terletak di Aricia dekat Danau Nemi.
claims.quote: The most important sanctuary of Diana for the ancient Romans was located at Aricia, some eleven miles outside of Rome on the shore of lake Nemi

claims.statement: A Met bronze statue depicts Artemis, known to Romans as Diana.
claims.statement_id: Patung perunggu yang dicatat The Met menampilkan Artemis yang disebut Diana oleh orang Romawi.
claims.quote: Artemis, known to the Romans as Diana, stands with her weight on her right leg, her left foot trailing.

claims.statement: According to most accounts, Diana's skill with the bow equaled that of her twin brother Apollo.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sebagian besar riwayat, keterampilan Diana memanah setara dengan saudara kembarnya, Apollo.
claims.quote: according to most accounts, her skill with the bow unquestionably equaled that of her twin brother Apollo.

claims.statement: In the Niobe story, an enraged Latona told Apollo and Diana to kill all 14 of Niobe's children.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Niobe, Latona yang murka menyuruh Apollo dan Diana membunuh keempat belas anak Niobe.
claims.quote: Latona was enraged and told Apollo and Diana to kill all 14 of Niobe's children.

claims.statement: Choosing never to marry, Diana received her father's permission to remain a virgin, joining Vesta and Minerva as the only virgin goddesses.
claims.statement_id: Diana memilih tidak menikah dan mendapat izin dari ayahnya untuk tetap perawan, bergabung dengan Vesta dan Minerva sebagai satu-satunya dewi perawan.
claims.quote: Choosing never to marry, Diana received permission from her father to remain a virgin, joining Vesta and Minerva as the only virgin goddesses.

claims.statement: In the Endymion story, Diana caused the youth to fall into an eternal sleep, fearing his beauty might be marred by toil and exposure.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Endymion, Diana membuat pemuda itu tertidur abadi karena takut kecantikannya rusak oleh kerja keras dan cuaca.
claims.quote: Fearing that his beauty might be marred by toil and exposure, Diana caused him to fall into an eternal sleep.

claims.statement: In the Orion story, Diana hit a target that turned out to be Orion swimming at night, and in her grief turned Orion and Sirius into a constellation.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Orion, Diana mengenai sasaran yang ternyata adalah Orion yang sedang berenang malam, lalu dalam dukanya ia mengubah Orion dan Sirius menjadi rasi bintang.
claims.quote: Diana, of course, hit it, but the target turned out to be Orion out for a nightly swim. In her grief, she turned Orion and Sirius into a constellation.

claims.statement: When the nymphs asked Diana for help, she turned them into pigeons.
claims.statement_id: Ketika para nimfa memohon bantuan, Diana mengubah mereka menjadi merpati.
claims.quote: the nymphs could go no further and asked Diana for help. She turned them into pigeons.

claims.statement: In the Trojan War story, an angered Diana stilled the waters so that the Greek ships could not sail.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Perang Troya, Diana yang marah menenangkan perairan sehingga kapal-kapal Yunani tidak dapat berlayar.
claims.quote: Diana, angry at his impudence, stilled the waters, preventing the Greek ships from sailing.

claims.statement: When Iphigenia was about to be sacrificed, Diana intervened and replaced her with a deer; she later became a priestess at Diana's temple.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Iphigenia hendak dikurbankan, Diana turun tangan dan menggantikannya dengan seekor rusa; Iphigenia kemudian menjadi pendeta di kuil Diana.
claims.quote: but Diana intervened, replacing her with a deer. She would become a priestess at Diana's temple.

claims.statement: In the Aeneid, Diana is heartbroken at the death of Camilla, a favorite of hers.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Aeneid, Diana berduka atas kematian Camilla, yang menjadi kesayangannya.
claims.quote: Diana is heartbroken, for Camilla was a favorite of hers.

claims.statement: According to the 1911 Britannica, in Roman mythology Diana is an old Italian goddess, in later times identified with the Greek Artemis.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Britannica 1911, Diana dalam mitologi Romawi adalah dewi Italia kuno yang pada masa kemudian disamakan dengan Artemis Yunani.
claims.quote: DIANA, in Roman mythology, an old Italian goddess, in later times identified with the Greek Artemis

claims.statement: Her name, the feminine form of Janus (Dianus), shows she was originally an independent Italian deity.
claims.statement_id: Namanya, bentuk feminin dari Janus (Dianus), menunjukkan bahwa ia semula dewi Italia yang berdiri sendiri.
claims.quote: That she was originally an independent Italian deity is shown by her name, which is the feminine form of Janus (= Dianus).

claims.statement: According to the 1911 Britannica, Diana is essentially the goddess of the moon and light generally, presiding over wood, plain and water, the chase and war.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Britannica 1911, Diana pada dasarnya dewi bulan dan cahaya, yang menguasai hutan, dataran, air, perburuan, dan perang.
claims.quote: She is essentially the goddess of the moon and light generally, and presides over wood, plain and water, the chase and war.

claims.statement: As goddess of childbirth Diana was known, like Juno, as Lucina, the "bringer to light".
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewi kelahiran, Diana dikenal dengan nama Lucina, "pembawa ke cahaya", seperti Juno.
claims.quote: As the goddess of childbirth, she was known, like Juno, by the name of Lucina, the “bringer to light.”

claims.statement: As moon-goddess Diana was also identified with Hecate and invoked as "three-formed" in reference to the phases of the moon.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewi bulan, Diana juga disamakan dengan Hecate dan dipanggil "berwujud tiga" merujuk pada fase bulan.
claims.quote: As the moon-goddess she was also identified with Hecate, and invoked as “three-formed” in reference to the phases of the moon.

claims.statement: Her most celebrated shrine was in a grove at Aricia near Lake Nemi (hence her title Nemorensis), where she was worshipped alongside Virbius, a god of the forest and the chase.
claims.statement_id: Tempat sucinya yang paling termasyhur ada di hutan kecil di Aricia dekat Danau Nemi (maka gelar Nemorensis); di sana ia dipuja bersama dewa Virbius, dewa hutan dan perburuan.
claims.quote: Her most celebrated shrine was in a grove at Aricia (whence her title of Nemorensis) near the modern lake of Nemi. Here she was worshipped side by side with a male deity Virbius, a god of the forest and the chase.

claims.statement: Diana's priest at Aricia, called Rex Nemorensis, was a runaway slave obliged to qualify for office by slaying his predecessor in single combat.
claims.statement_id: Pendeta Diana di Aricia, disebut Rex Nemorensis, adalah budak pelarian yang harus membunuh pendahulunya dalam duel untuk memenuhi syarat jabatan.
claims.quote: her priest, called Rex Nemorensis, who was a runaway slave, was obliged to qualify for office by slaying his predecessor in single combat

claims.statement: The worship of Diana was brought to Rome by Latin plebeians, so she was regarded as protectress of the lower classes and especially of slaves.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan Diana dibawa ke Roma oleh kaum plebeian Latin, sehingga ia dipandang sebagai pelindung kelas bawah dan terutama budak.
claims.quote: The worship of Diana was brought to Rome by Latin plebeians, and hence she was regarded as the protectress of the lower classes, and especially of slaves.

claims.statement: Diana's most important temple at Rome was on the Aventine, chief seat of the plebeians, founded by Servius Tullius originally as a sanctuary of the Latin league.
claims.statement_id: Kuil terpenting Diana di Roma berada di Aventine, pusat kaum plebeian, didirikan oleh Servius Tullius semula sebagai tempat suci liga Latin.
claims.quote: her most important temple was that on the Aventine, the chief seat of the plebeians, founded by Servius Tullius, originally as a sanctuary of the Latin league

claims.statement: No man was allowed to enter the temple, and on its dedication day (August 13) the slaves kept holiday.
claims.statement_id: Laki-laki dilarang memasuki kuil itu, dan pada hari penahbisannya (13 Agustus) para budak berlibur.
claims.quote: No man was allowed to enter the temple, and on the day of its dedication (August 13) the slaves kept holiday

claims.statement: The goddess's festival was on the ides (13th) of August; she was worshipped with torches, and women sought her aid for a happy delivery in childbirth.
claims.statement_id: Pesta Diana jatuh pada idus (13) Agustus; ia dipuja dengan obor, dan kaum perempuan memohon bantuannya untuk persalinan yang selamat.
claims.quote: The festival of the goddess was on the ides (13th) of August, the full moon of the hot season. She was worshipped with torches, her aid was sought by women seeking a happy deliverance in childbirth, and many votive offerings have been found on the site.

claims.statement: As Noctiluca, "giving light by night", Diana had a sanctuary on the Palatine kept illuminated all night.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai Noctiluca, "pemberi cahaya di malam hari", Diana memiliki tempat suci di Palatine yang diterangi sepanjang malam.
claims.quote: As Noctiluca (“giving light by night”) she had a sanctuary on the Palatine which was kept illuminated throughout the night

claims.statement: Another celebrated sanctuary of Diana was on the slopes of Mount Tifata near Capua, where she was worshipped as Tifatina.
claims.statement_id: Tempat suci Diana lain yang termasyhur berada di lereng Gunung Tifata dekat Capua, tempat ia dipuja dengan nama Tifatina.
claims.quote: Another celebrated sanctuary of Diana was that on the slopes of Mount Tifata near Capua (where she was worshipped under the name of Tifatina)

claims.statement: In Ovid's Metamorphoses the valley of Gargaphia is sacred to Diana, dense with pine trees and pointed cypress.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovid, lembah Gargaphia disebut keramat bagi Diana dan lebat oleh pohon pinus dan cemara runcing.
claims.quote: There is a valley called Gargaphia; sacred to Diana, dense with pine trees and the pointed cypress

claims.statement: In Ovid, Diana, the Sylvan goddess, loved to bathe in the crystal pool of that valley when wearied with sport.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ovid, di lembah itu Diana, sang dewi hutan, gemar mandi di kolam jernih setelah lelah berburu.
claims.quote: Here, when a-wearied with exciting sport, the Sylvan goddess loved to come and bathe her virgin beauty in the crystal pool.

claims.statement: In Ovid's Actaeon story, Diana wished her arrows were at hand but, having only water, dashed it on the young man's face.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Actaeon menurut Ovid, Diana berharap panahnya ada di tangan, tetapi hanya memiliki air yang ia percikkan ke wajah pemuda itu.
claims.quote: Oh, how she wished her arrows were at hand! But only having water, this she took and dashed it on his manly countenance

claims.statement: In Ovid, Diana fixed a great stag's horns on Actaeon's brows, lengthened his neck, made his ears sharp, and changed his hands and feet.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ovid, Diana memasang tanduk rusa jantan besar pada dahi Actaeon, memanjangkan lehernya, meruncingkan telinganya, dan mengubah tangan serta kakinya.
claims.quote: No more she threatened, but she fixed the horns of a great stag firm on his sprinkled brows; she lengthened out his neck; she made his ears sharp at the top; she changed his hands and feet;

claims.statement: In Ovid it is said that Diana's fury did not abate until the torn flesh ceased to live.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ovid, kemurkaan Diana tidak mereda sampai daging Actaeon yang tercabik berhenti hidup.
claims.quote: 'Tis said Diana's fury raged with none abatement till the torn flesh ceased to live.

claims.statement: In Ovid, Diana tells Actaeon to tell, if his tongue can, that his bold eyes saw her stripped of all her robes.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ovid, Diana berkata kepada Actaeon agar menceritakan, bila lidahnya mampu, bahwa matanya telah melihatnya tanpa busana.
claims.quote: Go tell it, if your tongue can tell the tale, your bold eyes saw me stripped of all my robes.

claims.statement: In Ovid, while the nymphs bathed Diana, Actaeon, wandering through unknown woods, entered the precincts of that sacred grove.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ovid, ketika para nimfa memandikan Diana, Actaeon yang mengembara di hutan tak dikenal memasuki hutan keramat itu.
claims.quote: And while they bathed Diana in their streams, Actaeon, wandering through the unknown woods, entered the precincts of that sacred grove;

claims.statement: Gaia is the primordial personification of Earth in Greek myth.
claims.statement_id: Gaia adalah dewi purba yang mempersonifikasikan Bumi dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: Gaia (also Gaea or Ge) is a primordial goddess and the personification of the Earth in Greek mythology.

claims.statement: In one creation account Gaia emerges from Chaos and is regarded as a mother goddess.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu kisah penciptaan, Gaia muncul setelah Chaos dan dipandang sebagai ibu para makhluk.
claims.quote: Gaia emerged from Chaos and is considered the supreme or mother goddess by immortals and mortals alike.

claims.statement: Gaia's Roman equivalent is Terra Mater or Tellus Mater.
claims.statement_id: Padanan Romawi Gaia ialah Terra Mater atau Tellus Mater.
claims.quote: Her Roman equivalent is Terra Mater or Tellus Mater.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Gaia bore Uranus, Ourea, and Pontus.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Gaia melahirkan Uranus, Ourea, dan Pontus.
claims.quote: Gaia emerged from Chaos (the great void) and gave birth to Uranus (Heaven), Ourea (Mountains), and Pontus (Sea).

claims.statement: Gaia and Uranus parented the twelve Titans.
claims.statement_id: Gaia dan Uranus adalah orang tua dua belas Titan.
claims.quote: She married her son Uranus, and together they had the 12 Titans

claims.statement: Gaia opposed Uranus after he hid their children deep in Earth.
claims.statement_id: Gaia menentang Uranus setelah ia menyembunyikan anak-anak mereka di kedalaman Bumi.
claims.quote: Uranus hated his children and hid them away out of sight in the depths of the earth. Gaia was heartbroken over how her children were being treated by their father and devised a plan to destroy him.

claims.statement: Gaia advised Zeus to free the Hecatoncheires and Cyclopes during the Titan war.
claims.statement_id: Gaia menasihati Zeus membebaskan Hekatonkheires dan Cyclopes dalam perang melawan Titan.
claims.quote: During the tenth year of the battle, Gaia gave council to Zeus and told him to free the Hecatoncheires and the Cyclopes from Tartarus

claims.statement: After the Titans' defeat, Gaia sent the Giants against the Olympian gods.
claims.statement_id: Sesudah kekalahan Titan, Gaia mengirim para Raksasa melawan para dewa Olimpus.
claims.quote: After the Titans were defeated and sent down to Tartarus by Zeus and the Olympian deities, Gaia sent her children, the Giants, to destroy the Olympians.

claims.statement: Gaia was said to bear Typhon with Tartarus.
claims.statement_id: Gaia dikisahkan melahirkan Typhon bersama Tartarus.
claims.quote: In revenge, Gaia lay with Tartarus and bore her youngest child, Typhon, the biggest monster ever born.

claims.statement: One tradition holds that the Delphic oracle originally belonged to Gaia.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu tradisi menyatakan orakel Delphi mula-mula milik Gaia.
claims.quote: The Oracle at Delphi originally belonged to Gaia, who later handed over the rights to her daughters Themis and Phoebe

claims.statement: Greek vase painting shows Gaia as a matronly woman rising from Earth.
claims.statement_id: Pada lukisan vas Yunani, Gaia tampil sebagai perempuan dewasa yang muncul dari Bumi.
claims.quote: In Greek vase painting Gaia was depicted as a buxom, matronly woman rising from the earth, inseparable from her native element.

claims.statement: In Hesiod's Theogony, Chaos came first, and next wide-bosomed Earth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Theogony Hesiod, mula-mula Chaos ada, lalu Bumi yang berdada lapang.
claims.quote: Verily at the first Chaos came to be, but next wide-bosomed Earth

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side and be an abiding place for the blessed gods.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi pertama-tama melahirkan Langit berbintang yang setara dengannya, untuk menutupinya dari segala sisi dan menjadi tempat tinggal para dewa.
claims.quote: And Earth first bare starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side, and to be an ever-sure abiding-place for the blessed gods.

claims.statement: In Hesiod, a straitened Earth groaned, made a great sickle from grey flint, and told her plan to her sons.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi yang terhimpit mengerang, membuat sabit besar dari batu api kelabu, dan menceritakan rencananya kepada putra-putranya.
claims.quote: But vast Earth groaned within, being straitened, and she made the element of grey flint and shaped a great sickle, and told her plan to her dear sons.

claims.statement: In Hesiod, the wily Cronos took courage and answered his mother, and Earth rejoiced, hid him in an ambush, put a jagged sickle in his hands, and revealed the whole plot to him.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Cronos yang licik menjawab ibunya dengan berani, lalu Bumi bersukacita, menyembunyikannya dalam penyergapan, memberinya sabit bergerigi, dan menyingkapkan seluruh rencana kepadanya.
claims.quote: But great Cronos the wily took courage and answered his dear mother ... vast Earth rejoiced greatly in spirit, and set and hid him in an ambush, and put in his hands a jagged sickle, and revealed to him the whole plot.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Earth received the drops of blood and later bore the strong Erinyes and the great Giants with gleaming armour.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi menerima tetesan darah itu dan kemudian melahirkan Erinyes yang kuat dan para Raksasa besar berbaju zirah berkilau.
claims.quote: all the bloody drops that gushed forth Earth received, and as the seasons moved round she bare the strong Erinyes and the great Giants with gleaming armour

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Cronos swallowed his children as each was born because he learned from Earth and starry Heaven that he was destined to be overcome by his own son.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Cronos menelan anak-anaknya begitu lahir karena ia mengetahui dari Bumi dan Langit berbintang bahwa ia ditakdirkan dikalahkan oleh putranya sendiri.
claims.quote: These great Cronos swallowed as each came forth from the womb to his mother's knees with this intent, that no other of the proud sons of Heaven should hold the kingly office amongst the deathless gods. For he learned from Earth and starry Heaven that he was destined to be overcome by his own son, strong though he was, through the contriving of great Zeus.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Earth carried Zeus through the black night and hid him in a remote cave on Mount Aegeum.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi membawa Zeus melintasi malam gelap dan menyembunyikannya dalam gua terpencil di Gunung Aegeum.
claims.quote: Zeus, the youngest of her children. Him did vast Earth receive from Rhea in wide Crete to nourish and to bring up. Thither came Earth carrying him swiftly through the black night to Lyctus first, and took him in her arms and hid him in a remote cave beneath the secret places of the holy earth on thick-wooded Mount Aegeum

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Earth gave a great stone wrapped in swaddling clothes to the mightily ruling son of Heaven, the earlier king of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi memberikan sebongkah batu besar berbalut kain kepada putra Langit yang berkuasa, raja para dewa terdahulu.
claims.quote: but to the mightily ruling son of Heaven, the earlier king of the gods, she gave a great stone wrapped in swaddling clothes.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, the wily Cronos was beguiled by Earth's deep suggestions and brought up his offspring again.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Cronos yang licik terperdaya oleh bujukan Bumi dan memuntahkan kembali anak-anaknya.
claims.quote: great Cronos the wily was beguiled by the deep suggestions of Earth, and brought up again his offspring

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, the gods brought them up again to the light at Earth's advising; she explained that with them the gods would gain victory.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, para dewa membawa mereka naik kembali ke cahaya atas nasihat Bumi, yang menjelaskan bahwa dengan mereka para dewa akan menang.
claims.quote: brought them up again to the light at Earth's advising. For she herself recounted all things to the gods fully, how that with these they would gain victory and a glorious cause to vaunt themselves.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Earth bore her youngest child Typhoeus from the love of Tartarus.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi melahirkan anak bungsunya, Typhoeus, dari cinta Tartarus.
claims.quote: huge Earth bare her youngest child Typhoeus of the love of Tartarus, by the aid of golden Aphrodite.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, three other sons were born of Earth and Heaven, great and doughty beyond telling: Cottus, Briareos and Gyes.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi dan Langit melahirkan tiga putra lain yang luar biasa besar dan gagah, yaitu Cottus, Briareos, dan Gyes.
claims.quote: three other sons were born of Earth and Heaven, great and doughty beyond telling, Cottus and Briareos and Gyes, presumptuous children.

claims.statement: Gaia was the goddess of the earth.
claims.statement_id: Gaia adalah dewi bumi.
claims.quote: GAIA (Gaea) was the goddess of the earth.

claims.statement: According to Theoi, Gaia was the great mother of all creation: the heavenly gods came from her union with Ouranos, the sea-gods from Pontos, the Giants from Tartaros, and mortal creatures directly from her flesh.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theoi, Gaia adalah ibu agung seluruh ciptaan: para dewa langit lahir dari persatuannya dengan Ouranos, dewa laut dari Pontos, para Raksasa dari Tartaros, dan makhluk fana langsung dari dagingnya.
claims.quote: Gaia was the great mother of all creation--the heavenly gods were descended from her through her union with Ouranos (Uranus) (Sky), the sea-gods from her union with Pontos (Sea), the Gigantes (Giants) from her mating with Tartaros (the Pit), and mortal creatures born directly from her earthy flesh.

claims.statement: According to Theoi, Gaia was the chief antagonist of the heavenly gods; first she rebelled against her husband Ouranos, who had imprisoned several of her giant-sons within her womb.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theoi, Gaia adalah lawan utama para dewa langit; pertama-tama ia memberontak melawan suaminya, Ouranos, yang memenjarakan putra-putra raksasanya dalam rahimnya.
claims.quote: Gaia was the chief antagonist of the heavenly gods. First she rebelled against her husband Ouranos (Sky) who had imprisoned several of her giant-sons within her womb.

claims.statement: According to Theoi, Gaia birthed a tribe of Giants and later the monster Typhoeus to overthrow Zeus, but both failed.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theoi, Gaia melahirkan suku Raksasa dan kemudian monster Typhoeus untuk menggulingkan Zeus, tetapi keduanya gagal.
claims.quote: She birthed a tribe of Gigantes (Giants) and later the monster Typhoeus to overthrow him, but both failed in their attempts.

claims.statement: Gaia appears as a divine being as early as the Homeric poems; in the Iliad black sheep were sacrificed to her and she was invoked in oaths.
claims.statement_id: Gaia tampil sebagai makhluk ilahi sejak puisi-puisi Homeros; dalam Iliad domba hitam dikurbankan kepadanya dan ia dipanggil dalam sumpah.
claims.quote: She appears in the character of a divine being as early as the Homeric poems, for we read in the Iliad (iii. 104) that black sheep were sacrificed to her, and that she was invoked by persons taking oaths.

claims.statement: Because Ge was seen as the source of the vapours producing divine inspiration, she herself was also regarded as an oracular divinity.
claims.statement_id: Karena Ge dipandang sebagai sumber uap yang menimbulkan ilham ilahi, ia sendiri juga dianggap dewi peramal.
claims.quote: As Ge was the source from which arose the vapours producing divine inspiration, she herself also was regarded as an oracular divinity

claims.statement: Her worship appears to have been universal among the Greeks, with temples or altars at Athens, Sparta, Delphi, Olympia, Bura, Tegea, Phlyus and other places.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan Gaia tampaknya meluas di kalangan bangsa Yunani, dengan kuil atau altar di Athena, Sparta, Delphi, Olympia, Bura, Tegea, Phlyus, dan tempat lain.
claims.quote: Her worship appears to have been universal among the Greeks, and she had temples or altars at Athens, Sparta, Delphi, Olympia, Bura, Tegea, Phlyus, and other places.

claims.statement: Gaia also bore the three one-eyed Cyclopes and the three Hecatoncheires, the hundred-handed and fifty-headed Giants.
claims.statement_id: Gaia juga melahirkan tiga Cyclopes bermata satu dan tiga Hecatoncheires, raksasa berlengan seratus dan berkepala lima puluh.
claims.quote: Gaia also bore the three one-eyed Cyclopes (Brontes, Arges, and Steropes) and the three Hecatoncheires, the hundred-handed and fifty-headed Giants (Kottos, Gyes, and Briareus).

claims.statement: With Pontus, Gaia gave birth to the sea gods and goddesses Thaumas, Phorcys, Ceto, and Eurybia.
claims.statement_id: Bersama Pontus, Gaia melahirkan dewa-dewi laut Thaumas, Phorcys, Ceto, dan Eurybia.
claims.quote: With Pontus, Gaia gave birth to the sea gods and goddesses Thaumas, Phorcys, Ceto, and Eurybia.

claims.statement: A pregnant Rhea approached Gaia for help, and Gaia helped her escape to Crete, where she gave birth to Zeus.
claims.statement_id: Rhea yang hamil meminta bantuan Gaia, yang menolongnya melarikan diri ke Kreta tempat ia melahirkan Zeus.
claims.quote: A pregnant Rhea approached Gaia for help, and Gaia helped her escape to Crete, where she gave birth to Zeus.

claims.statement: Gaia foretold that Cronus would be overthrown by his son and prophesied that Zeus and Metis would have a strong, wise daughter and a son who would become king of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Gaia meramalkan bahwa Cronus akan digulingkan putranya dan bahwa Zeus dan Metis akan mempunyai seorang putri yang kuat dan bijak serta seorang putra yang menjadi raja para dewa.
claims.quote: Just as Gaia foretold that Cronus would be overthrown by his son, she also prophecised that Zeus and his wife Metis would have a daughter who would be strong and wise like her father and a son who would become king of the gods in Zeus' place.

claims.statement: An oracle said the gods needed a mortal made invulnerable by a magic herb to defeat the Giants; Gaia searched for the herb, but Zeus prevented her from finding it.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah orakel menyebut para dewa memerlukan seorang fana yang dibuat kebal oleh ramuan ajaib untuk mengalahkan para Raksasa; Gaia mencari ramuan itu, tetapi Zeus mencegahnya menemukannya.
claims.quote: An oracle told the Olympian gods that they could not defeat the Giants on their own but needed the help of a mortal who would be made invulnerable by a magic herb. Once Gaia learned of this prophecy, she searched for the herb. However, Zeus prevented her from finding the herb

claims.statement: The Giants were unmatched in size and strength and fearful to behold, with feet of dragon scales and long hair.
claims.statement_id: Para Raksasa tak tertandingi dalam ukuran dan kekuatan, menakutkan, berkaki bersisik naga dan berambut panjang.
claims.quote: The Giants were unmatched in size and strength and fearful to behold, with feet made from dragon scales and long hair hanging from their head and cheeks.

claims.statement: Gaia gave Zeus and Hera golden apples from a magical tree that granted immortality to anyone who possessed them.
claims.statement_id: Gaia memberi Zeus dan Hera hadiah apel emas dari pohon ajaib yang memberi keabadian kepada siapa pun yang memilikinya.
claims.quote: Gaia gave them a gift of golden apples, which grew on a magical tree and granted immortality to anyone who was in possession of them.

claims.statement: According to some writers, Gaia transformed Daphne into a laurel tree to save her when she cried out for help.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sebagian penulis, Gaia mengubah Daphne menjadi pohon salam untuk menyelamatkannya ketika ia berseru minta tolong.
claims.quote: she cried out for help. Gaia transformed her into a laurel tree to save her.

claims.statement: Other sources say Apollo stole the oracle from Gaia after killing Python, the serpent who guarded the Delphic Oracle.
claims.statement_id: Sumber lain menyebut Apollo merebut orakel dari Gaia setelah membunuh Python, ular penjaga orakel Delphi.
claims.quote: Other sources say that Apollo stole the oracle from Gaia after killing Python, the serpent who guarded the Delphic Oracle.

claims.statement: According to the ancient poem Eumolpia, Gaia and Poseidon shared the oracle until Gaia gave her share to Themis.
claims.statement_id: Menurut puisi kuno Eumolpia, Gaia dan Poseidon berbagi orakel itu sampai Gaia memberikan bagiannya kepada Themis.
claims.quote: According to the ancient poem Eumolpia, Gaia and Poseidon shared the oracle until Gaia gave her share to Themis.

claims.statement: After giving up Delphi, Gaia was still consulted as an oracle at Aegeira in Achaea, where her priestess drank bull's blood.
claims.statement_id: Setelah melepaskan Delphi, Gaia masih dimintai ramalan di Aegeira di Akhaia, tempat pendetanya meminum darah banteng.
claims.quote: After giving up Delphi, Gaia was still consulted as an oracle at Aegeira in Achaea, where her priestess drank bull's blood.

claims.statement: Gaia has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to her, calling her the "mother of men" and the nourisher and giver of all.
claims.statement_id: Gaia memiliki Himne Orfik yang didedikasikan kepadanya, yang menyebutnya "ibu manusia" serta pemberi makan dan pemberi segalanya.
claims.quote: Gaia has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to her, where she is referred to as the "mother of men" and the nourisher and giver of all.

claims.statement: According to Orphism, Phanes gave birth to Nyx and then had Gaia and Uranus with her.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Orfisme, Phanes melahirkan Nyx dan kemudian memiliki Gaia dan Uranus bersamanya.
claims.quote: Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night) and then had Gaia and Uranus with her.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod (c. 700 BCE) in his Theogony, Gaia emerged from Chaos.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod (sekitar 700 SM) dalam Theogony, Gaia muncul dari Chaos.
claims.quote: According to Hesiod (c. 700 BCE) in his Theogony, Gaia emerged from Chaos

claims.statement: In revenge, Gaia lay with Tartarus and bore her youngest child, Typhon, the biggest monster ever born.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai balas dendam, Gaia berbaring bersama Tartarus dan melahirkan anak bungsunya, Typhon, monster terbesar yang pernah lahir.
claims.quote: In revenge, Gaia lay with Tartarus and bore her youngest child, Typhon, the biggest monster ever born.
