claims.statement: Minerva was a Roman goddess of wisdom, crafts, arts, and later war.
claims.statement_id: Minerva adalah dewi Romawi yang dikaitkan dengan kebijaksanaan, kerajinan, seni, dan kemudian perang.
claims.quote: Minerva was the Roman goddess of wisdom, medicine, commerce, handicrafts, poetry, the arts in general, and later, war.

claims.statement: Minerva was associated with Greek Athena and patronized Quinquatras.
claims.statement_id: Minerva dekat dengan Athena Yunani dan menjadi pelindung festival Quinquatras.
claims.quote: In many ways similar to the Greek goddess Athena, she had important temples in Rome and was patron of the Quinquatras festival.

claims.statement: Scholarly consensus traces Minerva to the Etruscan goddess Menrva.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian sarjana menelusuri Minerva pada dewi Etruska Menrva.
claims.quote: The scholarly consensus, however, is that Minerva was indigenous, passing to the Romans from the Etruscan goddess Menrva

claims.statement: In myth Minerva was born from Jupiter's head.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitos, Minerva dilahirkan dari kepala Jupiter.
claims.quote: Considered the daughter of Jupiter, from whose head she was born

claims.statement: Minerva belonged to the Capitoline Triad with Jupiter and Juno.
claims.statement_id: Minerva termasuk dalam Triad Kapitolin bersama Jupiter dan Juno.
claims.quote: the goddess was first worshipped in Rome as one of the Capitoline Triad along with Jupiter and Juno.

claims.statement: Arachne boasted that her weaving surpassed Minerva's.
claims.statement_id: Arachne menyombongkan keterampilan tenunnya melebihi Minerva.
claims.quote: In the myth, a Lydian girl named Arachne unwisely boasts that her weaving skills are even better than Minerva's.

claims.statement: Minerva challenged Arachne to a weaving contest.
claims.statement_id: Minerva menantang Arachne dalam pertandingan menenun.
claims.quote: she promptly challenged the presumptuous Arachne to a weaving competition.

claims.statement: In Ovid's tale, Minerva transformed Arachne into a spider.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Ovid, Minerva mengubah Arachne menjadi laba-laba.
claims.quote: punished Arachne for her audacity by hitting her on the head three times and changing her into a spider.

claims.statement: A shrine to Minerva was built on the Aventine in 263 or 262 BCE.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah tempat suci Minerva dibangun di Bukit Aventine pada 263 atau 262 SM.
claims.quote: Perhaps the most important site of worship of Minerva was on the Aventine where a shrine was built in either 263 or 262 BCE.

claims.statement: A Met bronze bust of Minerva bears a Greek-style helmet.
claims.statement_id: Patung perunggu Minerva di The Met menampilkan helm bergaya Yunani.
claims.quote: Modeled on the Greek goddess Athena, the Roman Minerva had many of the same duties and attributes, as shown here by her Greek-style helmet.

claims.statement: The Capitoline Triad including Minerva was central to Roman state religion.
claims.statement_id: Triad Kapitolin yang mencakup Minerva menjadi pusat agama negara Romawi.
claims.quote: Together with Jupiter and Juno, she formed part of the Capitoline Triad, the very center and focus of Roman state religion.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia her name derives from meminisse, meaning 'to remember'.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, namanya berasal dari meminisse yang berarti "mengingat".
claims.quote: and that her name derives from meminisse, meaning 'to remember'.

claims.statement: In legend Aeneas brought a cult statue of the goddess to Rome; housed in the Temple of Vesta, it was believed the city would be safe as long as the statue was preserved.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda, Aeneas membawa arca pemujaan sang dewi ke Roma; di Kuil Vesta diyakini kota itu aman selama arca itu terjaga.
claims.quote: In legend, the great hero Aeneas, who escaped from fallen Troy, brought a cult statue of the goddess to Rome. Residing within the Temple of Vesta it was believed that the city would be safe from harm as long as the statue was preserved.

claims.statement: Like Athena, Minerva was renowned for her chastity and once famously refused the amorous advances of Mars, the god of war.
claims.statement_id: Seperti Athena, Minerva termasyhur karena kesuciannya dan pernah menolak rayuan Mars, dewa perang.
claims.quote: Like Athena, the goddess was renowned for her chastity, and she once famously refused the amorous advances of Mars, the god of war.

claims.statement: Over time Minerva became the most important focus of the Quinquatrus festival, previously Mars's domain; the five-day festival began on 19 March and marked the start of the Roman army's campaign season.
claims.statement_id: Seiring waktu Minerva menjadi fokus terpenting pesta Quinquatrus yang semula milik Mars; pesta lima hari itu dimulai 19 Maret dan menandai awal musim kampanye tentara Romawi.
claims.quote: Over time, Minerva grew in stature within the Roman pantheon and she took over as the most important focus of the Quinquatrus festival, previously the domain of Mars. The five-day festival began on the 19th of March and marked the beginning of the campaign season for the Roman army.

claims.statement: Minerva also became associated with victory, as illustrated by Pompey's dedication of a temple to her after his campaigns in the east.
claims.statement_id: Minerva juga dikaitkan dengan kemenangan, seperti terlihat dari persembahan kuil oleh Pompeius setelah kampanyenya di timur.
claims.quote: The goddess also became associated with victory, as illustrated by Pompey's dedication of a temple to the goddess following his successful campaigns in the east.

claims.statement: The emperor Domitian claimed Minerva as his special protectress and commissioned a temple to her in the Nerva Forum in Rome in the second half of the 1st century CE.
claims.statement_id: Kaisar Domitianus menyatakan Minerva pelindung khususnya dan membangun kuil baginya di Forum Nerva di Roma pada paruh kedua abad ke-1 M.
claims.quote: The emperor Domitian also claimed the goddess was his special protectress and he commissioned a temple to her in the Nerva Forum in Rome in the second half of the 1st century CE.

claims.statement: The 3 metre high statue of Minerva in the Capitoline Museums in Rome, dating to the 2nd century BCE, shows a standing figure who wears a chiton and belt and an aegis with Medusa, carries a shield on her left arm, and wears a Corinthian helmet pushed to the back of the head.
claims.statement_id: Arca Minerva setinggi tiga meter di Museum Capitolini, Roma, bertarikh abad ke-2 SM; sosok berdirinya mengenakan chiton dan ikat pinggang, aegis dengan Medusa, membawa perisai di lengan kiri, dan mengenakan helm Korintus yang didorong ke belakang kepala.
claims.quote: One of the most impressive representations of Minerva in art is the 3 metre high statue of the goddess which now resides in the Capitoline Museums in Rome. Dating to the 2nd century BCE, the standing figure wears a chiton and belt, an aegis with Medusa, carries a shield on her left arm and wears a Corinthian helmet pushed to the back of the head.

claims.statement: The Aventine Minerva was of Greek origin, and the site was also home to a guild of writers and actors and an important centre for craftsmen.
claims.statement_id: Wujud Minerva di Aventine berasal dari Yunani, dan tempat itu juga lokasi perkumpulan penulis dan aktor serta pusat penting pengrajin.
claims.quote: This particular incarnation of the goddess - Aventine Minerva - was of Greek origin and the site was also the location of a writers and actors guild and an important centre for craftsmen.

claims.statement: In the Arachne story, Minerva's tapestry showed the great gods and Minerva herself winning the competition with Poseidon to become patron of Athens.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Arachne, tapestri Minerva menampilkan para dewa dan Minerva sendiri memenangkan perlombaan melawan Poseidon untuk menjadi pelindung Athena.
claims.quote: Minerva's masterpiece showed all the great gods and had Minerva herself taking centre-stage in the act of winning the competition with Poseidon to become patron of Athens.

claims.statement: Minerva is an Italian goddess, later identified with Athena, who presided over all handicrafts, inventions, arts and sciences.
claims.statement_id: Minerva adalah dewi Italia yang kemudian disamakan dengan Athena dan menguasai segala kerajinan, penemuan, seni, dan ilmu.
claims.quote: MINERVA, an Italian goddess, subsequently identified with Athena. She presided over all handicrafts, inventions, arts and sciences.

claims.statement: Minerva's oldest sanctuary at Rome was in the temple built by Tarquin on the Capitol, where she was worshipped with Jupiter and Juno.
claims.statement_id: Tempat suci tertua Minerva di Roma berada di kuil yang dibangun Tarquin di Capitol, tempat ia dipuja bersama Jupiter dan Juno.
claims.quote: Her oldest sanctuary at Rome was in the temple built by Tarquin on the Capitol, where she was worshipped with Jupiter and Juno.

claims.statement: Minerva also had a temple on the Aventine, the meeting-place for dramatic poets and actors.
claims.statement_id: Minerva juga memiliki kuil di Aventine, tempat pertemuan penyair drama dan aktor.
claims.quote: She had also a temple on the Aventine, which was the meeting-place for dramatic poets and actors

claims.statement: The temple's dedication day, 19 March, was Minerva's great festival, called quinquatrus because it fell on the fifth day after the ides.
claims.statement_id: Hari penahbisan kuil itu, 19 Maret, adalah pesta besar Minerva yang disebut quinquatrus karena jatuh pada hari kelima sesudah idus.
claims.quote: The dedication day of the temple was the 19th of March, the great festival of Minerva, called quinquatrus, because it fell on the fifth day after the ides.

claims.statement: At this festival all schools had holidays, and pupils on reassembling brought a fee (minerval) to the teachers.
claims.statement_id: Pada pesta itu semua sekolah libur, dan murid yang kembali membawa bayaran (minerval) kepada guru.
claims.quote: All the schools had holidays at this time, and the pupils on reassembling brought a fee (minerval) to the teachers.

claims.statement: In every house the quinquatrus was also a holiday, for Minerva was patron of women's weaving and spinning and the workmen's craft.
claims.statement_id: Di setiap rumah quinquatrus juga hari libur karena Minerva adalah pelindung tenun dan pintal kaum perempuan serta kerajinan para pekerja.
claims.quote: In every house also the quinquatrus was a holiday, for Minerva (like Athena Erganē) was patron of the women’s weaving and spinning and the workmen’s craft.

claims.statement: At a later time the festival was extended to five days, the last four given to gladiatorial shows, because Minerva was goddess of war.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa kemudian pesta itu diperpanjang lima hari, empat hari terakhir untuk pertunjukan gladiator, karena Minerva adalah dewi perang.
claims.quote: the last four being chiefly occupied with gladiatorial shows—because Minverva was goddess of war

claims.statement: The temple Pompey erected from the spoils of his eastern conquests shows she was the bestower of victory, like Athena Nike.
claims.statement_id: Kuil yang didirikan Pompeius dari rampasan penaklukannya di timur menunjukkan bahwa Minerva adalah pemberi kemenangan, seperti Athena Nike.
claims.quote: The erection of a temple to her by Pompey out of the spoils of his eastern conquests shows that she was the bestower of victory, like Athena Nikē

claims.statement: Under Domitian, who claimed her special protection, the worship of Minerva attained its greatest vogue in Rome.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa Domitianus, yang mengaku dilindunginya secara khusus, pemujaan Minerva mencapai puncak kepopulerannya di Roma.
claims.quote: Under Domitian, who claimed her special protection, the worship of Minerva attained its greatest vogue in Rome.

claims.statement: There was another temple of Minerva on the Caelian Hill, where she was worshipped as Capta, "the captive", whose origin is unknown.
claims.statement_id: Ada kuil Minerva lain di Bukit Caelius, tempat ia dipuja dengan nama Capta, "tawanan", yang asal-usulnya tidak diketahui.
claims.quote: There was another temple of Minerva on the Caelian Hill, where she was worshipped under the name of Capta, the “captive,” the origin of which is unknown.

claims.statement: There a festival called the lesser quinquatrus was celebrated on 13-14 June, chiefly by the flute-players.
claims.statement_id: Di kuil itu pesta quinquatrus kecil dirayakan pada 13-14 Juni, terutama oleh para pemain seruling.
claims.quote: Here a festival called the lesser quinquatrus was celebrated on the 13th–14th of June, chiefly by the flute-players

claims.statement: A carved image of the goddess called the Palladium, said to have been brought from Troy to Lavinium and then to Rome by the family of the Nautii, was kept in the temple of Vesta and carefully guarded for the city's prosperity.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah arca ukir sang dewi yang disebut Palladium, konon dibawa dari Troya ke Lavinium lalu ke Roma oleh keluarga Nautii, disimpan di kuil Vesta dan dijaga ketat demi kemakmuran kota.
claims.quote: A carved image of the goddess called the Palladium, said to have been brought from Troy to Lavinium, and thence to Rome by the family of the Nautii, was kept in the temple of Vesta and carefully guarded as necessary to the prosperity of the city.

claims.statement: According to the 1911 Britannica, the older form of the name Minerva is Menerva, which probably means "thinker".
claims.statement_id: Menurut Britannica 1911, bentuk lama nama Minerva adalah Menerva, yang mungkin berarti "pemikir".
claims.quote: The older form of the name Minerva is Menerva ... it probably means “thinker.”

claims.statement: Since the Romans learnt the flute from the Etruscans, Minerva's role as patron of flute-players favours an Etruscan origin, although it may merely echo the Greek story about Athena.
claims.statement_id: Karena bangsa Romawi belajar seruling dari Etruska, kedudukan Minerva sebagai pelindung pemain seruling mendukung asal-usul Etruskanya, meski mungkin hanya gema kisah Yunani tentang Athena.
claims.quote: As the Romans learnt the use of the flute from the Etruscans, the fact of Minerva being the patron goddess of flute-players is in favour of her Etruscan origin, although it may merely be a reminiscence of the Greek story which attributed the invention of the flute to Athena.

claims.statement: In Ovid, Minerva puts aside the shape of the old woman and reveals herself as the goddess Minerva.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva menanggalkan wujud perempuan tua dan menyingkapkan dirinya sebagai dewi Minerva.
claims.quote: Minerva comes to you!” And with those brief words, put aside the shape of the old woman, and revealed herself, Minerva, goddess.

claims.statement: In Ovid, Minerva wove the Athenian Hill of Mars and the old contention over the city's name.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva menenun Bukit Mars di Athena dan perselisihan lama tentang nama kota itu.
claims.quote: Minerva worked the Athenian Hill of Mars, where ancient Cecrops built his citadel, and showed the old contention for the name it should be given.

claims.statement: In Ovid, Minerva wove a portrait of herself bearing a shield and a lance in her hand.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva menenun potret dirinya yang membawa perisai dan tombak di tangannya.
claims.quote: And then she wove a portrait of herself, bearing a shield, and in her hand a lance,

claims.statement: In Ovid, Minerva ripped Arachne's web and struck her on the head with her boxwood shuttle repeatedly.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva merobek tenunan Arachne dan menghantam kepalanya dengan teropong buksus berulang kali.
claims.quote: she ripped the web, and ruined all the scenes that showed those wicked actions of the Gods; and with her boxwood shuttle in her hand, struck the unhappy mortal on her head,—struck sharply thrice, and even once again.

claims.statement: In Ovid, Minerva, moved to pity, saved Arachne from that death but, still angry, pronounced another doom.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva tergerak iba dan menyelamatkan Arachne dari kematian, tetapi masih marah lalu menjatuhkan hukuman lain.
claims.quote: Minerva, moved to pity at the sight, sustained and saved her from that bitter death; but, angry still, pronounced another doom:

claims.statement: In Ovid, Minerva sprinkled Arachne with juice of herbs of Hecate, so her hair, nose and ears fell away and her body shrank.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva memercikkan sari ramuan Hecate kepada Arachne sehingga rambut, hidung, dan telinganya lenyap serta tubuhnya mengecil.
claims.quote: she sprinkled her with juice—extract of herbs of Hecate. At once all hair fell off, her nose and ears remained not, and her head shrunk rapidly in size, as well as all her body, leaving her diminutive.

claims.statement: In Ovid, ever since, Arachne as a spider weaves her web.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ovid, sejak itu Arachne sebagai laba-laba menenun jaringnya.
claims.quote: and ever since, Arachne, as a spider, weaves her web.

claims.statement: Freyja is a Norse goddess of fertility, love, and beauty, also linked to magic and war.
claims.statement_id: Freyja adalah dewi Nordik kesuburan, cinta, dan keindahan yang juga berkaitan dengan sihir serta perang.
claims.quote: Freyja is the goddess of fertility, love and beauty, but she is also associated with magic and war.

claims.statement: Freyja is Njord's daughter, Freyr's sister, and a member of the Vanir.
claims.statement_id: Freyja adalah putri Njord, saudari Freyr, dan anggota kelompok dewa Vanir.
claims.quote: She is the daughter of the sea god Njord and the twin sister of Freyr, who, like her, belongs to the family of gods known as the Vanir.

claims.statement: Freyja's staff signifies mastery of seiðr, a magic associated with foresight.
claims.statement_id: Tongkat Freyja melambangkan penguasaannya atas seiðr, sihir untuk melihat masa depan.
claims.quote: Freyja often carries a staff, a sign of her mastery of seiðr, a form of magic through which one can see into the future.

claims.statement: Freyja is said to have taught seiðr and divination to Odin.
claims.statement_id: Freyja dikisahkan mengajarkan seiðr dan ramalan kepada Odin.
claims.quote: It is Freyja who teaches Odin, foremost of the Æsir, how to practise seiðr and the art of divination.

claims.statement: Freyja travels in a chariot drawn by two great cats.
claims.statement_id: Kereta Freyja ditarik oleh dua kucing besar.
claims.quote: When Freyja travels, she does so in a chariot drawn by two great cats

claims.statement: Freyja receives half the battle dead in Fólkvangr; the other half go to Odin's Valhalla.
claims.statement_id: Freyja menerima separuh prajurit gugur di Fólkvangr, sementara separuh lain menuju Valhalla Odin.
claims.quote: As a goddess of battle, she receives half of the slain warriors into her hall, Fólkvangr, while the other half go to Odin in Valhalla.

claims.statement: Freyja wore the coveted necklace Brísingamen.
claims.statement_id: Freyja memiliki kalung Brísingamen yang sangat diinginkan.
claims.quote: Freyja wore a jewel called Brísingamen. It was the most beautiful necklace in the world and greatly coveted.

claims.statement: In one tale Loki becomes a flea to steal Freyja's necklace.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu kisah, Loki berubah menjadi kutu untuk mencuri kalung Freyja.
claims.quote: Loki saw that the clasp was at her neck. He changed into a flea, bit her on the cheek, and waited until she turned in her sleep.

claims.statement: The Old Norse name Freyja means lady or mistress.
claims.statement_id: Nama Freyja dalam Nordik Kuno berarti perempuan atau nyonya.
claims.quote: Freyja (Old Norse for 'Lady', 'Woman', or 'Mistress') is the best-known and most important goddess in Norse mythology.

claims.statement: One of Freyja's attributes is a garment of falcon feathers.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu atribut Freyja adalah pakaian dari bulu elang.
claims.quote: Another is a garment - a coat, cloak or dress-like thing - made out of falcon feathers.

claims.statement: Place-names in Sweden and Norway suggest Freyja's worship, though cult details are sparse.
claims.statement_id: Nama tempat di Swedia dan Norwegia menunjukkan jejak pemujaan Freyja, meski rincian kultusnya terbatas.
claims.quote: The Old Norse sources do not specifically detail the existence of a cult of Freyja per se, but the large number of place-names in Sweden and Norway related to her name

claims.statement: Name: Freyja (also spelt Freja, Freyia).
claims.statement_id: Nama: Freyja (juga ditulis Freja, Freyia).
claims.quote: Name: Freyja (also spelt Freja, Freyia)

claims.statement: According to the myth, Freyja lived in a splendid, well-guarded house that no one could enter without her leave.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos, Freyja tinggal di rumah megah yang dijaga ketat, yang tidak boleh dimasuki siapa pun tanpa izinnya.
claims.quote: She lived in a splendid and well-guarded house, into which no one could enter without her leave.

claims.statement: According to the myth, four dwarfs proposed that Freyja lie with each of them for a night in exchange for the jewel, and she agreed.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos, empat kurcaci meminta Freyja menemani masing-masing semalam sebagai ganti permata itu, dan Freyja menyetujuinya.
claims.quote: They proposed that she should lie with each of them for one night in exchange for the jewel. Freyja agreed to the bargain.

claims.statement: Odin agreed to return the jewel only if Freyja first used her magic to cast a spell on two mighty kings, forcing them to fight each other in an eternal battle.
claims.statement_id: Odin setuju mengembalikan permata itu hanya jika Freyja lebih dahulu memakai sihirnya untuk menjatuhkan mantra pada dua raja perkasa agar bertarung abadi.
claims.quote: Odin agreed to return the jewel, but only if Freyja first used her magic. He required her to cast a spell upon two mighty kings, forcing them to fight each other in an eternal battle.

claims.statement: The Swedish History Museum holds a Viking Age silver pendant thought to depict Freyja.
claims.statement_id: Museum Sejarah Swedia menyimpan liontin perak Zaman Viking yang diperkirakan menggambarkan Freyja.
claims.quote: Viking Age silver pendant thought to depict Freyja.

claims.statement: According to the museum, Freyja symbolises love, fertility, beauty, and seiðr (Old Norse magic).
claims.statement_id: Lambang Freyja menurut museum adalah cinta, kesuburan, kecantikan, dan seiðr (sihir Nordik Kuno).
claims.quote: Symbolism: Love, fertility, beauty, seiðr (Old Norse magic)

claims.statement: Freyja's father is Njord; her mother's name is not mentioned in the sources.
claims.statement_id: Ayah Freyja adalah Njord; nama ibunya tidak disebut dalam sumber.
claims.quote: Parents: Njord (father) – her mother’s name is not mentioned in the sources

claims.statement: According to the myth, Freyja was Odin's lover.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos, Freyja adalah kekasih Odin.
claims.quote: According to the myth, Freyja was Odin’s lover.

claims.statement: According to the Younger Edda, Freyja is the most famous of the goddesses; she has a dwelling in heaven called Folkvang, and when she rides to battle half of the slain belong to her and half to Odin.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Edda Muda, Freyja adalah dewi paling termasyhur; ia punya tempat tinggal di surga bernama Folkvang, dan ketika ia berkuda ke pertempuran separuh yang gugur menjadi miliknya dan separuh lagi milik Odin.
claims.quote: Freyja is the most famous of the goddesses. She has in heaven a dwelling which is called Folkvang, and when she rides to the battle, one half of the slain belong to her, and the other half to Odin.

claims.statement: According to the Younger Edda, Oder went far away and Freyja weeps for him, but her tears are red gold.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Edda Muda, Oder pergi jauh dan Freyja menangisinya, tetapi air matanya adalah emas merah.
claims.quote: Oder went far away. Freyja weeps for him, but her tears are red gold.

claims.statement: Freyja has many names because she changed her name among the nations she visited in search of Oder: Mardol, Horn, Gefn, Syr, and Vanadis; she has the necklace Brising.
claims.statement_id: Freyja punya banyak nama karena ia berganti nama di berbagai bangsa saat mencari Oder: Mardol, Horn, Gefn, Syr, dan Vanadis; ia memiliki kalung Brising.
claims.quote: Freyja has many names, and the reason therefor is that she changed her name among the various nations to which she came in search of Oder. She is called Mardol, Horn, Gefn, and Syr. She has the necklace Brising, and she is called Vanadis.

claims.statement: Freyja is ranked with Frigg and wedded to Oder; their daughter is Hnos, so fair that all things fair and precious are called by her name.
claims.statement_id: Freyja disejajarkan dengan Frigg dan bersuami Oder; putri mereka bernama Hnos, yang begitu cantik sehingga semua yang indah dan berharga disebut dengan namanya.
claims.quote: The sixth is Freyja, who is ranked with Frigg. She is wedded to the man whose name is Oder; their daughter’s name is Hnos, and she is so fair that all things fair and precious are called, from her name, Hnos.

claims.statement: In the story of the builder, he demanded Freyja as his reward, and the sun and moon besides.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah tukang bangunan, ia menuntut Freyja beserta matahari dan bulan sebagai upahnya.
claims.quote: But he demanded as his reward, that he should have Freyja, and he wanted the sun and moon besides.

claims.statement: At Balder's funeral pyre, Freyja drove her cats.
claims.statement_id: Pada pembakaran jenazah Baldr, Freyja mengendarai kucing-kucingnya.
claims.quote: Heimdal rode his steed Gulltop, and Freyja drove her cats.

claims.statement: Loki promised to bring Idun back from Jotunheim if Freyja would lend him the falcon-guise that she had.
claims.statement_id: Loki berjanji membawa Idun kembali dari Jotunheim jika Freyja meminjamkan wujud elang yang dimilikinya.
claims.quote: he became frightened, and promised to bring Idun back from Jotunheim if Freyja would lend him the falcon-guise that she had.

claims.statement: In the Ynglinga account, Njord's daughter Freyja was priestess of the sacrifices and first taught the Asaland people the magic art, as practised among the Vanaland people.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan Ynglinga, Freyja putri Njord adalah pendeta kurban dan pertama kali mengajarkan seni sihir kepada orang Asaland, seperti yang lazim di antara orang Vanaland.
claims.quote: Njord’s daughter, Freyja, was priestess of the sacrifices, and first taught the Asaland people the magic art, as it was in use and fashion among the Vanaland people.

claims.statement: Njord afterward had two children, a son named Frey and a daughter named Freyja, fair of face and mighty.
claims.statement_id: Njord kemudian memiliki dua anak, putra bernama Frey dan putri bernama Freyja, yang rupawan dan perkasa.
claims.quote: Njord, in Noatun, afterward begat two children: a son, by name Frey, and a daughter, by name Freyja. They were fair of face, and mighty.

claims.statement: Freyja became so celebrated that all women of distinction were called by her name, whence they have the title Frue.
claims.statement_id: Freyja menjadi begitu termasyhur sehingga semua perempuan terpandang dipanggil dengan namanya, maka mereka bergelar Frue.
claims.quote: Freyja alone remained of the gods, and she became on this account so celebrated that all women of distinction were called by her name, whence they now have the title Frue

claims.statement: Freyja's husband was called Oder, and her daughters Hnos and Gersame.
claims.statement_id: Suami Freyja bernama Oder, dan putri-putrinya Hnos dan Gersame.
claims.quote: Her husband was called Oder, and her daughters Hnos and Gersame.

claims.statement: In the Þrymskviða the giant Thrym steals Thor's hammer and demands Freyja; Freyja refuses to go and gives up the Brísingamen to help Thor disguise himself as her.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Þrymskviða, raksasa Thrym mencuri palu Thor dan menuntut Freyja; Freyja menolak ikut dan menyerahkan Brísingamen untuk membantu Thor menyamar sebagai dirinya.
claims.quote: The story tells of Thor's hammer being stolen by the giant Thrym, who will not return the hammer unless he gets his hands on Freyja. Freyja refuses to tag along, however, giving up the Brísingamen to help Thor disguise himself as her.

claims.statement: In the Hyndluljóð, Freyja visits the wise-woman Hyndla and asks her to unravel the hero Óttar's ancestry.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Hyndluljóð, Freyja mengunjungi perempuan bijak Hyndla dan memintanya mengurai silsilah pahlawan Óttar.
claims.quote: The Hyndluljóð poem emphasises she was more than just a pretty face; in it, Freyja visits wise-woman Hyndla asking her to unravel the hero Óttar's ancestry, soaking up this knowledge.

claims.statement: The boar Hildisvíni may be counted among Freyja's attributes; in the Hyndluljóð she rides it.
claims.statement_id: Babi hutan Hildisvíni mungkin termasuk atribut Freyja; dalam Hyndluljóð ia menungganginya.
claims.quote: Possibly, the boar Hildisvíni should also be counted among Freyja's attributes; the Hyndluljóð poem has her riding said boar

claims.statement: Freyja is also a goddess of wealth, as attested by the many poetic references linking her to treasure.
claims.statement_id: Freyja juga dewi kekayaan, sebagaimana dibuktikan banyak rujukan puitis yang mengaitkannya dengan harta.
claims.quote: Freyja is also a goddess of wealth, as attested to by the many poetic references that link her to treasure.

claims.statement: Ódr is said to have gone on long journeys, leaving Freyja behind, who searched for him weeping golden tears; this tale dates back to at least the 10th century CE.
claims.statement_id: Ódr konon pergi mengembara dan meninggalkan Freyja, yang lalu mencarinya sambil menangis air mata emas; kisah ini berasal sekurangnya dari abad ke-10 M.
claims.quote: Ódr is said to have gone traipsing around on long journeys, inexplicably leaving Freyja behind, who would then search for him while weeping golden tears; this tale dates back to at least as early as the 10th century CE.

claims.statement: The Sǫrla Þáttr, preserved in the 14th-century Flateyjarbók, describes Freyja sleeping with four dwarves to get the Brísingamen and Odin forcing Loki to steal it.
claims.statement_id: Sǫrla Þáttr dalam Flateyjarbók abad ke-14 M menceritakan Freyja tidur dengan empat kurcaci demi Brísingamen, dan Odin lalu memaksa Loki mencurinya.
claims.quote: the Sǫrla Þáttr, which survives in the 14th century CE Flateyjarbók, describes how Freyja sleeps with four dwarves to get the Brísingamen, and how Odin then forces Loki to steal the necklace from her.

claims.statement: By contrast, Snorri Sturluson has Loki and Heimdall fighting each other over the necklace.
claims.statement_id: Sebaliknya, Snorri Sturluson menggambarkan Loki dan Heimdall berkelahi memperebutkan kalung itu.
claims.quote: By contrast, Snorri Sturluson has Loki and Heimdall fighting each other over the necklace (Skáldskaparmál, 8).

claims.statement: The Brísingamen is assigned to Freyja by Late Old Norse sources (13th and 14th centuries CE).
claims.statement_id: Brísingamen dikaitkan dengan Freyja oleh sumber-sumber Nordik Kuno akhir (abad ke-13 dan ke-14 M).
claims.quote: Regarding her necklace Brísingamen, which is assigned to Freyja by Late Old Norse sources (13th and 14th centuries CE)

claims.statement: According to a scholar quoted by World History Encyclopedia, Freyja is one of the few individual goddesses who had a major role in the more official religious cult.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sarjana yang dikutip World History Encyclopedia, Freyja adalah salah satu dari sedikit dewi perorangan yang berperan besar dalam kultus keagamaan yang lebih resmi.
claims.quote: Freyja is one of the few individual goddesses who has had a major role in the more official religious cult

claims.statement: Place-names such as Frøihov ("Freyja's temple") and Frǫvi ("Freyja's shrine") show clear worship, perhaps even a public cult.
claims.statement_id: Nama tempat seperti Frøihov ("kuil Freyja") dan Frǫvi ("tempat suci Freyja") menunjukkan pemujaan yang jelas, mungkin bahkan kultus publik.
claims.quote: such as Frøihov (from Freyjuhof, 'Freyja's temple') and Frǫvi (from Freyjuvé, 'Freyja's shrine'), show clear worship, perhaps even pointing to a public cult

claims.statement: The people of Iceland on the cusp of conversion to Christianity around the year 1000 CE still clearly had Freyja on their mind.
claims.statement_id: Orang Islandia menjelang peralihan ke agama Kristen sekitar tahun 1000 M masih jelas mengingat Freyja.
claims.quote: It is clear that the people of Iceland on the cusp of conversion to Christianity around the year 1000 CE still had Freyja clearly on their mind.

claims.statement: Freyja's other name Horn probably comes from Old Norse horr, meaning flax or linen.
claims.statement_id: Nama lain Freyja, Horn, mungkin berasal dari kata Nordik Kuno horr yang berarti rami atau linen.
claims.quote: Specifically, her other name Horn (Hǫrn, or Härn) probably comes from Old Norse horr, which means flax or linen.

claims.statement: Another of Freyja's names, Gefn, is Old Norse for "giver", bringing to mind a role as a goddess of plenty.
claims.statement_id: Nama lain Freyja, Gefn, berarti "pemberi" dalam bahasa Nordik Kuno, yang mengingatkan pada peran dewi kelimpahan.
claims.quote: Another one of her names, Gefn, is Old Norse for 'giver', bringing to mind a role as a goddess of plenty.

claims.statement: Sýr, another name of Freyja, is sometimes translated "sow" but might also mean "to protect" or "to shield".
